summary: Uses an index table to select, reorder, and duplicate rows or columns from a lookup table by numeric index or matching values.

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Choose whether the index table selects rows or columns

key_params.name: valueloction
key_params.note: Official parameter for where lookup values are found in the lookup table

key_params.name: valuename
key_params.note: Row or column name used when matching by value

key_params.name: valueindex
key_params.note: Numeric row or column index used when matching by value

key_params.name: includeheader
key_params.note: Include source headers in the output table

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Lookup DAT requires two inputs: an index table first and the lookup table second.
Index mode and value-matching mode have different semantics; generated networks should name the intent clearly.
Output order follows the index table, so the same lookup row or column can be selected multiple times.
Missing or duplicate keys need upstream validation when the output drives automation.
key_concepts: Looks up values from a table using an index table or column/row reference.
The official parameter id is spelled valueloction and must be preserved for compatibility.
Value Name and Value Index choose the row or column supplying looked-up values.
Include Header controls whether the output includes the source header row or column.
